name: text-soft-mask-wipe
title: Soft Gradient Mask Wipe
description: Chữ hiện dần từ trái sang qua một mép mặt nạ mềm rộng 70 px; khi rời cảnh, mép mềm quét tiếp cùng chiều làm chữ biến mất.

moworks.author: takayu

options.feather: px of the soft edge (240; 70 on the site's demo)
options.exit: s after the start when a second edge hides it left to right (1.2 s ease-in-out; null: stay)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-soft-mask-wipe, written here): Text masked by a linear gradient (opaque → transparent; demo soft edge 70 px; CSS stops 40 % → 60 % of a mask 250 % wide, so the soft band is half the text width). The edge moves from left of the text to past its right edge (mask-position 100 % → 0) over 1.2 s easeOutCubic (power2.out), revealing left → right. Exit: a second edge follows the same way, hiding left → right, 1.2 s easeInOutCubic (demo 2.8–4.0 s). Demo in 0.3–1.5 s; loop 4.2 s. Params: duration (1.2 s) · feather: độ mềm mép (70 px) · ease (easeOutCubic) · exit (1.2 s).
